subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this stale maintainer prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into current sub-agent guidance, or paused/closed because current main already covers the intended delegation behavior?
rationale: The remaining blocker is prompt-policy direction across model-facing guidance and nested sub-agent semantics; automation should not decide whether to preserve or change that contract for a protected maintainer-labeled PR.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
options.body: Resolve the stale merge state and fold useful examples into the existing availability- and depth-aware prompt/tool-description guidance so there is one policy source.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If maintainers want to forbid nested sub-agents, update runtime behavior, config schema/help, docs, and tests together instead of changing only prompt text.

options.title: Pause Or Close As Covered
options.body: If current main's guidance is sufficient, maintainers can pause or close this branch without carrying the stale prompt rubric forward.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the stale merge state and fold useful examples into the existing availability- and depth-aware prompt/tool-description guidance so there is one policy source.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged nested sub-agent orchestration work is the strongest current-main contract affected by the PR's blanket nested-spawn wording.
